decision_cruda.rationale: The radio says N600-11 is stopped for ventilation and LH-04 is free. The CMMS is empty, so radio and CMMS do not conflict and no confirmation is needed. Norte is already truck-limited. Its 3 trucks haul about 70 t/h, or roughly 450-470 t by 17:00. Against that, Norte has a 247 t stockpile plus about 59 t/h from LH-05 and LH-07 over 6.5 loading hours, about 630 t in all. Reserve RS-N600-02 or RS-N522-03 would therefore add almost nothing hauled. Este has spare truck capacity. Its stockpile is only 31 t, plus LH-02 at about 40 t/h gives about 290 t, against about 470 t of haulage. Moving LH-04 to RS-E569-01 costs about 0.65 h of travel plus 1.0 h of activation, so it starts around 11:40. At 220 m it mucks about 36 t/h for roughly 5.3 h, about 190 t, which the spare trucks can take. That is about 182 t at 9.2 g/t, or about 54 oz, less margin for travel and repair-time uncertainty, so I estimate about 45 oz net. I made no loans. Taking a loader from a development heading costs 1.3 to 4.2 oz per hour, and the extra production would not be hauled in truck-limited mines. LH-10 is in the workshop and is not a stope in carguio, so it cannot lend under LOADER-SOURCE-01.
